scripts.build:cf: npx @cloudflare/next-on-pages@latest && cp public/sitemap.xml .vercel/output/static/sitemap.xml && cp public/robots.txt .vercel/output/static/robots.txt && cp public/naver*.html .vercel/output/static/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path='.vercel/output/static/_routes.json'; const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path)); if(!r.exclude.includes('/naver*.html')) r.exclude.push('/naver*.html'); fs.writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(r));"
